verdict.rationale: The official repo advertises an optimized Docker image bundling a FastAPI server for easy deployment. A self-hosting docs section exists, and a real-time monitoring dashboard with browser-pool visibility supports production operation. A community member also built one-click Docker setups on top of it, though another notes new developers struggle with production configuration. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on production configuration (scaling, auth, env/resource tuning) and independent hands-on corroboration of the official image in production.
